user.label: user
user.what: Who you are: role, skills, way of working. Helps Claude adapt its explanations.
user.example: Senior Go developer, new to React; prefers short answers.

feedback.label: feedback
feedback.what: An instruction or correction you gave, with the reason (Why) and how to apply it (How to apply).
feedback.example: Never add an attribution line to commits.

project.label: project
project.what: Ongoing work, a decision or a constraint that cannot be derived from the code or git. Use absolute dates.
project.example: Merge freeze until November 5: mobile release in progress.

reference.label: reference
reference.what: Where to find information outside the repository: dashboard, ticket, document, channel.
reference.example: Ingestion bugs are tracked in the Linear project "INGEST".
